description: Dathent is an AI content assistant for brands. Set up your brand profile, get a weekly content plan, generate post drafts with captions and visuals, schedule them to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Telegram, and track how published posts perform — all from chat. Drafts are never auto-published without your confirmation.

defaultPrompt: Draft an Instagram and Facebook post about our new arrival and save it as a draft
Build a weekly content plan for my brand and show me the topics
How did my published posts perform this week?
